meta.description: The ORVIBO R2 Robot Vacuum & Mop empties itself into a 3 L dust station, cleans with 3000 Pa suction, finds its way with LDAR laser navigation and covers up to 350 m², on voice command through MixPad.
meta.spec.description: R2 Robot Vacuum & Mop specifications: LDAR laser navigation, 3000 Pa suction, 5200 mAh battery, 250 min runtime, 350 × 350 × 98 mm, 3 L dust station.
r2_banner.banner_title:
Take out the trash
once a season
hero.feature2: Sweeps, vacuums and mops at 3000 Pa
hero.feature3: No missed spots, no random bumping
hero.feature4: Voice control with MixPad, Xiao Ai or Tmall Genie
hero.feature5: An LED display shows when the bag is full
sec1.title:
Empties itself
One robot sweeps, vacuums and mops
sec1.desc: With ORVIBO's own Auto-cleaning 3.0 self-emptying technology, the robot empties its dust bin after every run: no sweeping, no mopping, no taking out the trash. Your hands are free.
sec2.title: No clogs, fast pickup, nothing left behind
sec2.desc: With ORVIBO's own Auto-cleaning 3.0 self-emptying technology, the robot empties its dust bin after every run: no sweeping, no mopping, no taking out the trash. Your hands are free.
alt.sec2_2: The ORVIBO dock: 1020 W of extra-high power and an extra-short 375 mm air duct. Other self-emptying robots: 950 W, low power, and a long 750 mm duct that clogs easily.
sec3.title: Smart LED display: see at a glance how full it is
alt.sec3: The dock's LED display shows: dust bag full, emptying, battery level. ORVIBO R2 robot vacuum: know the moment it's full. Other self-emptying robots: no LED display, so alerts are easy to miss and emptying easy to forget.
sec4.title:
Toss it once a season
Just 4 emptyings a year
sec4.desc: A built-in, fully sealed 3.0 L dust bag: throw it away when it's full, and forget frequent trips to the trash.
alt.sec4: The 3 L dust station holds as much as 10 dust bins of 300 ml.
sec5.title:
Hurricane-strength deep cleaning
Sweeps, vacuums and mops, not a speck left
alt.sec5: Sweep: nothing left. Vacuum: strong suction. Mop: lifts stains.
sec6.title:
3000 Pa of powerful suction
Spotless wherever it goes
sec6.desc: A Nidec brushless motor from Japan, 4 suction levels and a V-shaped floating roller brush: dust and dirt have nowhere to hide.
alt.sec6: Typical robot vacuum: 2200 Pa suction, small crumbs only. ORVIBO robot vacuum and mop: 3000 Pa extra-strong suction, picks up large debris, even steel balls.
sec7.title: LDAR laser navigation: fast AI mapping, precise cleaning
sec7.desc: ORVIBO's new LDAR laser navigation, developed in-house, quickly scans even complex homes and rebuilds the rooms' layout: faster, more accurate mapping, more reliable saved maps and precise real-time navigation around the clock.
alt.sec7: Gen 1, gyroscope navigation: low precision, errors build up over time. Gen 2, visual navigation: thrown off by light, bumps into things. Gen 3, LDAR laser navigation: fast, accurate maps, unfazed by obstacles.
sec8.title:
3D obstacle avoidance
Smart AI, no random bumps
sec8.desc: ORVIBO's new 3D obstacle avoidance algorithm scans, detects and steers around objects on the floor in real time, so it doesn't bump into things or cause trouble.
sec9.title:
350 m² cleaning area
Enough for a whole villa
sec9.desc: After its first few runs, it builds a map split into rooms. Name the rooms, and you can send the robot to any of them from MixPad.
alt.sec9: Maps of two floors with named rooms: bedroom, bedroom 2, guest room, WC, study, living room, dining room, kitchen, balcony
sec9.recharge: Returns to charge when the battery is low
sec9.resume: Charged, it picks up where it left off
sec10.title: Cleaning plans made for you: say where, and it cleans there
alt.sec10: In a bedroom, a woman tells the robot: “Butler, clean the bedroom and the kitchen.” The robot answers: “OK.”
alt.sec10_1: Custom rooms: extra care where it counts
alt.sec10_3: AI route planning: zone memory, multi-floor maps
alt.sec10_4: Cleans like you would: zigzag, Y and grid patterns
sec11.title: Voice control for the whole smart home: clean without getting up
sec11.desc: Control it by voice through the MixPad super smart switch, whether you are resting on the sofa or out of the house: the whole smart home at your command.
sec12.title:
New constant-pressure water tank
Precise spraying, wet mopping without leaks
sec12.desc: A small electronically controlled pump ends uncontrolled dripping, so your floors never get soaked.
alt.sec12: The R2 and its dust and water box on a wood floor; beside it, the robot on wood, on tiles and on a greasy floor
sec13.title: Playful voice replies: a robot vacuum with personality
alt.sec13: The robot talks: “Time to clean. Look how dirty this floor is!” and “This virtual wall is in my way. Can you move it?”
sec13.title2: Standout details, no corner left uncleaned
alt.sec14_1: Only 9.8 cm tall: slim enough to glide under beds
alt.sec14_2: Climbs 2 cm thresholds: never gets stuck, reaches every corner
alt.sec14_3: Drop protection: cliff sensors spot stairs and drops
alt.product: The black R2 on its dust station
install_params.params_item29: Dust bin: 300 ml, water tank: 250 ml
